entries.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Deliver a single square iOS app icon image for Lull, not a contact sheet or framed mockup. Target 1024x1024 PNG, fully opaque RGB, full bleed deep dusty-blue paper to every edge, unrounded square corners.
References: image1 sleeping Nat defines paper material and sleeping eyes; image2 sitting Nat defines the round head outline and folded ear. Character reference only: remove all body, tail and paws. Preserve Nat's recognizable identity.
Strict frontal flat paper collage viewed orthographically from directly above, with horizontal face/eye line, zero camera tilt, no perspective and no 3D volume. Exactly one background sheet, one large CIRCULAR moon, Nat's head in front of it, and exactly TWO small cream paper stars in the blue at upper left and upper right. No other objects.
Background is one sheet deep dusty-blue construction paper #3D4A63. Moon is a simple solid cream paper CIRCLE #F6EFD9 about80% ofcanvaswidth centered horizontally slightly above midpoint. NOT a crescent moon. Nat head about66% ofcanvaswidth, centered horizontally. Entire charcoal silhouette including both ears must be against cream moon, with a visible cream margin around all upper and side edges; never let either ear merge into blue. Keep wholeface and bothears withincentral80% square. A soft round head wider than tall, no body/paws visible. Left ear(viewer'sleft) is tall upright pointed charcoal. Right ear(viewer'sright) folds forward with ochre #D9A84E underside and tiny lighter-underfold shading in sameochre. Two SHORT cream sleeping-eye crescents with middle lower than ends like reference, identical calm closedeyes. Two round claypink #D99B7E cheeks. Tiny claypink triangle nose pointed down. No mouth, no whiskers.
Real matte cut construction paper, fine grain, just few subtlefibres, clean scissor-cut edges, tight small soft layer-contact shadows down/right from upper-left light. Fine material detail must not obscure clean silhouettes. NO leathergrain, coarsehair, felt, furry fabric, embossing, bevel, gloss, gradients, glow, outlines, vectorflatfills, plastic orclay. Flat paper has negligible thickness except right-ear fold. Only five paperpigments #3D4A63 #F6EFD9 #2B2523 #D9A84E #D99B7E; allow subtle natural papertexture/contactshading. Charcoalcat is #2B2523.
